manifest.description: Sends large files as a password-protected link from your Nextcloud.
manifest.tooltip: Send large files as a password-protected link from your Nextcloud.

addin.connect.title: Connect to Nextcloud
addin.connect.text: Large attachments are stored in your Nextcloud and sent as a password-protected link. This needs a one-time connection.
addin.connect.hint: Finish signing in in the browser and confirm “Grant access”.
addin.connect.done: The connection to Nextcloud has been set up.
addin.connect.incomplete: The sign-in was not completed. Please try again.
addin.disconnect.done: The connection to Nextcloud has been removed.
addin.disconnect.failed: The connection could not be removed: {error}
addin.unreachable: CloudShare cannot be reached at the moment ({url}).
addin.files.heading: Attachments
addin.files.none: This message has no file attachments.
addin.files.unsupported: This type of attachment cannot be transferred.
addin.drop.title: Drag files here
addin.share.heading: Sharing
addin.password.label: Password
addin.password.ruleClasses: At least three of: upper case, lower case, digits, special characters
addin.password.hint: After sending, the recipients automatically get the password in a separate message.
addin.password.hintNone: Anyone who knows the link can download the files. No message with a password is sent.
addin.password.hintSeparate: The next link gets a new password. After sending, the recipients get a separate message with the password for each link.
addin.password.hintLocked: This password applies to all files of this message. The recipients get it automatically after sending.
addin.password.hintLockedNone: The links of this message have no password – anyone who knows them can download the files.
addin.password.weak: The password does not meet all requirements yet.
addin.password.released: The CloudShare links were removed from the message. Password and options can be chosen again.
addin.expire.label: Link valid for
addin.expire.capped: At most {max} days are possible – the value was set to {max}.
addin.expire.changed_one: New links are valid for {count} day.
addin.expire.changed_other: New links are valid for {count} days.
addin.expire.keepExisting: Links already inserted keep their expiry date.
addin.maxAccess.label: Password can be opened
addin.maxAccess.hint: How often the recipients can open the password link; after that it is blocked.
addin.maxAccess.capped: At most {max} accesses are possible – the value was set to {max}.
addin.maxAccess.next: The password link can be opened {times}.
addin.maxAccess.nextStep: The password link can be opened {times} (for the next link).
addin.maxAccess.now: The password link can now be opened {times}.
addin.maxAccess.failed: “Password can be opened” could not be changed: {error}
addin.channel.label: Deliver the password
addin.channel.recipients: to the recipients of the message
addin.channel.sms: by text message to a mobile number
addin.channel.hintMail: Only this address gets the password – not the recipients of the message.
addin.channel.hintSms: After sending, the password goes to this number by text message – the recipients get no password message.
addin.channel.savedSms: After sending, the password goes to {to} by text message.
addin.channel.savedMail: The password is only sent to {to}.
addin.channel.savedRecipients: The password goes to the recipients of the message.
addin.channel.saveFailed: The way the password is delivered could not be saved: {error}
addin.channel.mailInvalid: Please enter exactly one valid email address for the password.
addin.channel.mailInvalidShort: Please enter a valid email address for the password.
addin.channel.mailMissing: Please enter the email address that should get the password – or choose “to the recipients of the message”.
addin.channel.smsInvalid: Please enter a valid mobile number, e.g. 07700 900123 or +44 7700 900123.
addin.channel.smsInvalidShort: Please enter a valid mobile number for the password, e.g. 07700 900123.
addin.channel.smsMissing: Please enter the mobile number that should get the password by text message – or choose another way.
addin.request.heading: Receive files from recipients
addin.request.text: The recipients get a link they can use to upload files to you – large ones too. The files end up in your Nextcloud. Password and validity as above.
addin.request.needsPassword: Upload links always need a password – please choose “Random password” or “Own password”.
addin.request.needsPasswordLocked: Upload links always need a password. This message already contains links without a password – please use a new message for it.
addin.request.inserted: The upload link was inserted. The password is sent automatically after sending.
addin.submit.noPassword_one: The file can be downloaded without a password.
addin.submit.noPassword_other: The files can be downloaded without a password.
addin.submit.passwordFollows: The password is sent automatically after sending.
addin.insert.failed: The link could not be inserted: {error}
addin.insert.notTaken: Outlook did not put the link into the message. Please click into the message body and insert it again – you can also copy the link under “My shares”.
addin.shares.hint: Your CloudShare links of the last 30 days
addin.shares.none: You have not shared any files with CloudShare yet.
addin.shares.smsFailed: not delivered – the password link went to you
addin.shares.insertLabel: Insert into this message as a new link
addin.shares.confirmLabel: Sure? Revoke share – choose again to confirm.
addin.shares.fateRequest: The files received stay in your Nextcloud.
addin.shares.fateDeleted: The file was moved to the trash of your Nextcloud.
addin.shares.fateScheduled_one: The file will be moved to the trash of your Nextcloud in {count} day.
addin.shares.fateScheduled_other: The file will be moved to the trash of your Nextcloud in {count} days.
addin.shares.fateKept: The file stays in your Nextcloud.
addin.shares.revokeFailed: The share could not be revoked: {error}
addin.shares.linked: A new link to “{name}” was inserted.
addin.shares.linkedNoPassword: It can be downloaded without a password.
addin.card.filesTitle_one: A file has been shared with you
addin.card.filesTitle_other: {count} files have been shared with you
addin.card.passwordNote: You will receive the password in a separate message.
addin.card.requestText: You can send me your files securely with the following link.
addin.card.requestPlain: You can send me your files securely with this link (valid until {date}):
addin.notify.enforce: they can only be sent as a password-protected Nextcloud link.
addin.notify.suggest: Send as a password-protected Nextcloud link?

addin.alert.useRibbon: Please send it via “CloudShare” in the ribbon.
addin.alert.suggest: Attachments over {mb} MB: {names}. CloudShare sends them as a password-protected Nextcloud link. “Send Anyway” sends them as normal attachments.
